title: Bodybeat, reimagined
question: Which screen would make you want to stand up and play? These are layout sketches; the build will use the existing silver, orange and pose colors.

options.label: Move into the spotlight
options.thesis: One enormous pose demonstration makes your body the star of the screen.
options.viewport: A large animated pose stage takes the left; a compact song selector, real waveform and Play occupy the right.
options.risk: The demonstration needs clearly labeled motion so it cannot be mistaken for live tracking.

options.label: Four moves. Your stage.
options.thesis: Four tall colored pose lanes fill the screen like the game you are about to enter.
options.viewport: The body poses dominate the first view; a compact bottom transport holds both songs, the waveform and Play.
options.risk: The colorful stage needs a disciplined transport area so song selection remains obvious.

options.label: Follow the beat
options.thesis: A wide pose sequence demonstrates the move-to-the-beat mechanic before you start.
options.viewport: A horizontal demonstration spans the page, with a clear hit marker above a slim song-selection and Play deck.
options.risk: A clearly labeled demonstration is essential; it must not imply that the song or camera has started.

regions.label: POSE DEMO: CUES APPROACH THE HIT MARKER
